metadata.dcterms:title: An asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic hypergeometric series
metadata.dcterms:creator: MORITA∗, Takeshi
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We show an asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic hypergeometric series 1ψ0(a; −; q, ·) with using the q-Borel-Laplace method. We also give the limit q →1 −0 of our asymptotic formula.
